Product Master: Slow-changing canonical product facts such as category, brand, model, specifications, lifecycle, aliases, and variants.
Market Observation: Time-sensitive market fact such as asking price, condition, warranty, source, evidence level, and observed timestamp.
Candidate: Unaccepted raw listing/search result collected from a provider or fixture.
Evidence: Private/admin proof supporting a candidate or observation, such as URL, snippet, screenshot path, or fetched page metadata.
Extraction: Structured fields produced from evidence by rules or AI; not accepted market truth.
Green Lane: High-confidence validation result. During calibration it is still review-gated.
Amber Lane: Ambiguous validation result requiring human review.
Red Lane: Rejected/quarantined result due to invalid listing type, weak evidence, duplicate, or invalid price.
Price Snapshot: Deterministic Q1/median/Q3 and confidence calculation from accepted observations.
Community Data Feedback Loop: Approved future architecture where users submit price/product/spec/staleness/sold-price feedback as evidence and market signals, not votes.
Community Submission: Future user-submitted feedback record with structured fields, optional evidence, confidence dimensions, review status, and audit trail.
Community Confidence Score: Future derived confidence from evidence, contributor trust, consensus, and freshness dimensions. It must never directly update price snapshots.
SOLD_PRICE_REPORT: Future community feedback type for reported final transaction price evidence. It is not verified sold-price truth until separately validated.
